findings.message: <div id="grain"> is a timeline element that contains nested <div id="grain-tex">. The timeline shows one row per top-level element, and the root composition is built only from sub-compositions.
findings.fixHint: Move <div id="grain"> and its contents into a sub-composition file and mount it with data-composition-src.

findings.message: 4 tl.fromTo() calls target "#chat-touch" with no stable baseline. The last-authored fromTo "from" values become the element's resting state for any seek before the first tween actually runs, because GSAP applies fromTo from-values at authoring time (immediateRender), not at tween position.
findings.fixHint: Add `immediateRender: false` to every fromTo except the earliest-positioned one (at 0s), so pre-first-tween seeks keep its "from" values. A hiding `tl.set(..., 0)` baseline trips gsap_timeline_set_initial_hide, and a `gsap.set` authored before the fromTo calls is overwritten by them.

findings.message: This HTML composition file has 647 lines. Smaller sub-compositions are easier to read, iterate on, and diff.
findings.fixHint: Split this sub-composition further into smaller .html files, then mount them from the parent with data-composition-src so each file stays small enough to inspect, revise, and validate independently.
